record.question: There are more than twenty files. Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'twenty'.
record.explanation: Answer C: adjective. Twenty modifies files and is a numeral adjective/determiner in the options’ school taxonomy (C). Independent check: “Twenty” quantifies the count noun “files”; traditional school grammar labels it a numeral adjective. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/numbers. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
